note: The session's web search allowance ran out after the first fifteen candidates, so the rest were looked up only on pages whose address could be worked out (school districts' own board pages, campaign addresses tried by name). Not reached: the Governor's press releases (the state's site refuses scripts, so the two appointments rest on news reports), Ballotpedia (empty answer), the Portage, Ferndale, Hamilton and Rochester board pages (their member lists are drawn by script), Bridgeport-Spaulding and Woodhaven-Brownstown (sites not found), the Washtenaw County Republican Party's own site (no answer; Tawn Beliger's site shows its endorsement letter, which does not count until seen on the party's page), and any party page for the Michigan State University trustee nomination. Holt's and Taylor's board pages do not list Elizabeth Fleckenstein or Christopher Rosen as members. No birth year was found on a page that could be used. A blank here means not looked up or not found, not that nothing exists.
